positive/.env:2:16  warning  EG016 unresolved-reference  APP_URL references HOST, which is not defined in positive/.env or the env files loaded with it
  variable: HOST
  why: Loaders that expand references substitute an empty string for an undefined HOST, so APP_URL silently ends up incomplete (for example a URL without a host).
  fix: Define `HOST=` in positive/.env (checked: positive/.env), give the reference a default such as `${HOST:-value}`, or add HOST to scanner.ignore_variables in .envguard.yaml if the process environment provides it.
  docs: https://github.com/ardamoustafa1/envguard/blob/main/docs/rules/EG016-unresolved-reference.md
